c0906.en: ▸ The daily cash count: starting bank, drawer count by denomination, POS Z report and over/short — plus the monthly log to see at a glance which days didn't balance.

c0907.en: How to use — Cash Drawer Opening

c0908.en: ▸ Count the starting bank and type the amount in the GREEN cell "Starting bank (opening float)". The closing sheet reads it from there: no need to retype it.

c0909.en: How to use — Cash Drawer Closing

c0910.en: ▸ In "Cash Count by Denomination" fill in ONLY the "Quantity" column (number of bills or coins, whole number): the subtotal and TOTAL CASH calculate themselves. The table has US bills and coins (the penny is no longer minted but is still legal tender; a "25¢ roll" counts $10 and a "10¢ roll" $5). In the UK, Canada or Australia, unprotect the sheet (no password) and change the label and value of each row.

c0911.en: ▸ In the "Closing Summary" you only type three figures: "Card sales, excl. tips", "Other tenders + card tips paid in cash" and "POS Z report: sales + tax, excl. tips" (net sales plus sales tax, without tips or gratuities; many POS "total" lines include tips). Everything else is a formula.

c0912.en: ▸ The starting bank is deducted automatically: TOTAL COLLECTED = (cash counted − starting bank) + card sales + other.

c0913.en: ▸ OVER / SHORT = TOTAL COLLECTED − POS Z report (sales + tax, excl. tips). If the cell turns AMBER, the drawer doesn't balance: check it BEFORE signing.

c0914.en: ▸ One row per day: enter starting bank, sales by payment type, POS Z report and deposit; Total Collected and Over/Short calculate themselves and the over/short turns amber.

c0915.en: ▸ The starting bank is a balance, not a sale: the TOTALS row shows the AVERAGE starting bank of the days logged, not their sum.

c0916.en: ▸ Everything filled in daily is GREEN: Assigned to, Due by, ✓ Done, Initials, Notes, the count quantities and the summary amounts.

c0995.en: "Cash Counted" is the drawer count AS IS, with the starting bank inside: Total Collected already deducts it. In TOTALS, "Starting Bank" is the AVERAGE starting bank of the days logged (a balance is not summed) and "Over/Short" is the CUMULATIVE over/short in absolute value: a +50 and a −50 make 100 of over/short, not 0. "Card Sales (no tips)" excludes tips; "Other + Tips Paid" = other tenders + card tips paid in cash from the drawer. "POS Z" = net sales + sales tax, without tips.
